enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed on the right side. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to the left side. Bend knees. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up to shoulders. Turn to the right side. Straighten legs. Move arm under pillow. Continue sleeping. Turn to the left side. Pull blanket down slightly. Breathe deeply. Remain still.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and using the toilet
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up in bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Use the toilet. Flush the toilet. Turn on the tap and wash face. Pick up toothbrush, apply toothpaste, brush teeth. Rinse mouth and wipe face with towel. Turn off tap and light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with coffee, listening to a podcast, having breakfast together with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, bread, and milk. Close refrigerator. Place ingredients on counter. Open cupboard and take out frying pan. Place pan on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Crack eggs into pan and stir with spatula. Place bread in toaster and press lever. Pour coffee into mug and add milk. Stir coffee with spoon. Set table with plates, mugs, and cutlery. Say 'Breakfast is ready' to Member 1. Sit at table with Member 1. Eat breakfast and drink coffee. Open podcast app on phone and play podcast. Talk with Member 1 about the day's plans. Clear dishes and place in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Sitting at the desk with the desk lamp on, sketching warm-up drawings and reviewing the art project brief
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to Bedroom 2. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up pencil from desk. Open sketchbook. Draw warm-up sketches of lines and shapes. Open art project brief on computer. Read the brief. Take notes on paper. Underline key points. Adjust desk lamp angle. Close sketchbook. Save notes file on computer. Stand up from desk. Walk out of Bedroom 2.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading news on the phone and planning the day's arts administration tasks
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open news app. Scroll through headlines. Read articles. Open calendar app. Review schedule. Open notes app. Type tasks for the day. Number tasks. Close phone. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Working from home at the desk on arts administration duties: emails, grant schedules and gallery coordination on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to Bedroom 2. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email client. Read new emails. Reply to emails. Open grant schedule spreadsheet. Update grant schedules. Make phone calls to gallery. Coordinate with gallery staff. Type notes. Use mouse to navigate. Open gallery coordination document. Update document. Save file. Check calendar. Send meeting invites. Organize files on desktop. Stand up and stretch. Sit back down. Continue working.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating a light lunch, reheating leftovers in the microwave, having lunch together with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out leftovers. Close refrigerator. Open microwave door. Place leftovers inside. Close microwave door. Set timer and press start. Wait for microwave to beep. Open microwave door. Take out container. Close door. Place container on counter. Get plate. Serve food onto plate. Sit at table. Eat lunch. Talk with Member 1. Clear dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a short midday walk around the neighborhood with Member 1 to get fresh air
enriched_activities.desc: Put on shoes. Open front door. Walk outside. Walk along sidewalk. Turn left at corner. Continue walking. Talk with Member 1. Turn around at halfway point. Walk back. Open front door. Enter house. Remove shoes. Close door.

enriched_activities.activity: Freelance illustration work on the computer and monitor, inking and colouring client artwork
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to Bedroom 2. Sit at desk. Turn on computer and monitor. Open drawing software. Open client artwork file. Select brush tool. Ink lines on artwork. Switch to color tool. Apply colors to artwork. Adjust layers. Use stylus on tablet. Save file. Open reference image. Compare colors. Adjust hue. Save again. Export file. Close software. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling the kettle for afternoon tea and having a snack
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Fill kettle with water. Place kettle on base. Turn on kettle. Open cupboard. Take out mug. Take out tea bag. Place tea bag in mug. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Kettle boils. Pour water into mug. Add milk to tea. Stir tea. Open pantry. Take out biscuits. Place biscuits on plate. Sit at table. Drink tea. Eat biscuits.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening walk around the neighbourhood to get some fresh air
enriched_activities.desc: Put on shoes. Open front door. Walk outside. Walk along sidewalk. Turn right at corner. Continue walking. Look around. Turn around at halfway point. Walk back. Open front door. Enter house. Remove shoes. Close door.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner on the induction cooker and eating it, having dinner together with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and protein. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Place pan on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Add oil to pan. Add vegetables and protein. Stir with spatula. Add spices. Cook for several minutes. Turn off induction cooker. Serve food onto plates. Set table. Call Member 1 to dinner. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Talk with Member 1. Clear dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV together with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Select channel. Watch TV. Talk with Member 1. Adjust volume. Change channel. Watch more TV. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and washing up
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap to body. Rub body with hands. Rinse body. Apply shampoo to hair. Rub hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on clean clothes. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on a personal illustration piece at the desk with the desk lamp on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to Bedroom 2. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open computer. Open illustration software. Open personal project file. Select brush tool. Draw outlines. Switch to color tool. Apply colors. Use stylus on tablet. Adjust layers. Save file. Open reference image. Compare colors. Adjust hue. Save again. Export file. Close software. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down with light TV and tidying the living area
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Select channel. Watch TV for a few minutes. Pick up items from sofa (e.g., books, clothes). Place items in their places. Fold blanket. Fluff pillows. Pick up any trash. Throw trash in bin. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Night routine: brushing teeth, washing and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth for two minutes. Rinse mouth with water. Wash face with water and cleanser. Dry face with towel. Apply moisturizer to face. Put away toiletries. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading in bed and falling asleep
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to Bedroom 2. Turn on bedside lamp. Pick up book. Get into bed. Open book. Read pages. Turn pages. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Turn off lamp. Lie down. Close eyes. Fall asleep.
